newsitem.title: UK: Shell's Jennings to retire as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Jennings to retire as chairman.

text.p: Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc said on Thursday that John Jennings, who has been chairman since 1993, would retire on June 30.
Jenning will continue to serve on the board, of which he has been a member since 1987. He will be succeeded as chairman by Mark Moody-Stuart on July 1, Shell said in a statement.
Moody-Stuart would also continue as group managing director of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group of companies, the company noted.

Meanwhile, Royal Dutch Petroleum Co, which owns 60 percent of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, said it would propose to shareholders at a meeting on May 14 that Jeroen van der Veer be appointed a managing director of the company from July 1.

The group wants van der Veer then appointed a member of the presidium of the board of Shell Petroleum N.V., a managing director of The Shell Petroleum Company Ltd and a director of Shell Petroleum Inc -- thereby becoming a group managing director, also with effect from July 1, 1997.
